decision: FREEZE → frozen_exploratory: FO01.S0 (primary), FO12.T2 (secondary), FO13.K0 (secondary). We freeze FO01.S0 as the primary EXPLORATORY football outcome because it has the strongest combination of football relevance, observed athlete coverage and preliminary across-game reliability among the candidates evaluated without consulting Combine-to-NFL predictive correlations. FO01.S0 uses the recorded separation_at_pass_forward field, whose precise provider semantics remain plausible but unconfirmed. FO01.S1 is operationally redundant with S0 in the observed population, while FO01.S2 shows lower preliminary reliability and is retained for sensitivity analysis only. FO12.T2 is retained as a secondary tackle-or-assist credit rate per eligible defensive snap, not as tackling success probability. FO13.K0 is retained as a secondary recorded sack outcome, not as a pass-rush win rate or opportunity-adjusted sack rate. The source definitions and opportunity denominators remain subject to their documented limitations. All subsequent football-transfer analyses are EXPLORATORY, and these outcomes must not be described as independently validated measures of player skill. This selection was made from semantic plausibility, coverage, reliability and physical interpretability rather than favorable Combine prediction results.
